release_name: Live TV v3.9.3 — Independent Phone TV Mobile Playback & Phone Remote
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📱 Independent Mobile TV Playback: Watch any of the 2,989 TV channels directly on your smartphone through the Phone Remote web app without interrupting or changing what is playing on the Mac screen
📺 Dual Channel Card Controls: Every channel card now features dedicated '📺 Mac' (tunes the big screen) and '📱 Phone' (streams directly on your smartphone) buttons
⚡ Quick Switch Bar & PiP: Switch mobile channels with a single tap beneath the player, with native iOS Safari HLS, Android Hls.js hardware decoding, and Mobile Picture-in-Picture
📡 'Send to Mac' Action: Transfer any stream you're watching on your phone directly to the Mac TV display with one touch
🕒 Bangladesh Standard Time (BST) & Live Scores: Retains all real-time cricket scores, overs, wickets, football match times, and uninterrupted SPOTV 2 HD playback
